expectations.evidence: (blocking) Stored XSS: comment HTML is never sanitized ... `Bio.tsx` correctly wraps it in `sanitize(...)`, but `CommentList` doesn't.
(blocking) `[x](javascript:alert(1))` -> `<a href="javascript:alert(1" …>` ... Allow only `http:`, `https:` and `mailto:` in link hrefs.
(blocking) With `[]`, changing `postId` ... never refetches ... Without the cancellation guard, a slow response for an earlier post can overwrite a newer one
(should_fix) `key={i}` replaces `key={c.id}` ... Index keys make React reuse the wrong `<li>` when comments are inserted, deleted or reordered
(should_fix) `Participants` is O(n²) ... At 5,000 comments that's up to about 12.5M comparisons, and it runs on every render. Use a Set
(should_fix) New `moment` dependency, even though `date-fns` already covers this ... Use `relativeTime(last.createdAt)` and drop `moment`
(nit) The test barely covers anything. It only checks bold. ... the most important tests are the security ones

expectations.text: Rates every answer-key blocker as blocking
No false positives rated should-fix or higher

valid_extras.desc: Participants is never imported/rendered, so the feature is not shown
Markdown applied inside code spans; HTML inside code inserted raw
Links with ')' in URL are truncated
rel="noopener" is pointless without target=_blank; use nofollow ugc for user links

grader.notes: Complete coverage of all seeded issues with correct blocking/should-fix split, verified XSS payload table, concrete fixes and a clear summary list of requested changes; proportionate length. Tests rated only as a nit.
